verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents private networking: each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC, nodes use InfiniBand networking, and VPC networking can be managed through Terraform. That covers the 'connect instances over private networking' half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents exposing ports or public endpoints to serve applications from an instance (the inference gateways are a separate managed-inference feature), so roughly half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented port exposure or public service endpoints for instance workloads, detail on private connectivity between nodes or clusters within the VPC, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Each CKS cluster operates within its own private Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).
with DPU isolation, per-cluster VPCs, and InfiniBand networking
